misses.text: PayPal is also a solid choice for Indonesian winners.
Alternatively, Skrill is a good option for you.
For India, Wise is a good alternative to Payoneer.
You can send USDC on Base to Tokocrypto instead.
Switch to USDC on Ethereum (ERC-20); it is widely supported by Tokocrypto.
Under Article 23 of the India treaty, your prize is taxable only in India.
Berdasarkan Pasal 16, hadiah Anda dapat dikenai tarif lebih rendah.
You will not owe any US tax on this.
Tidak ada pemotongan pajak untuk pembayaran USDC ini.
The treaty cuts the rate to a quarter.
Tokocrypto charges about 1 USDT to withdraw.
Seven thousand dollars minus fees comes to roughly four thousand eight hundred.
After the 30% withholding, you'll receive $4,900.00 in your Payoneer account.
Net of tax, $4,900.00 is yours to keep.
Konversi ke rupiah menghasilkan Rp 87.616.900 untuk Anda.
